articles.title: GitHub Launches Copilot Fusion to Automatically Select and Combine AI Models for Coding

articles.title: 319 Suspicious Chrome Extensions Hijack Default Search Settings Without Sensitive Permissions
articles.summary:

The dataset reportedly includes 38,628 order records from July 18–October 26, 2026, plus an activity index covering 10,139 distinct IP addresses.
